description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain with a location on Pacific Boulevard near the False Creek waterfront and Vancouver Seawall cycling corridor. The restaurant offers pizza by the slice or whole pie with any toppings, including a gluten-free cauliflower crust option, making it a quick and flexible stop for hungry cyclists. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available.
